sourceTitle: Lights and Shadows of New York Life or, the Sights and Sensations of the Great City
description: "Lights and Shadows of New York Life" by James Dabney McCabe is a descriptive work examining the various facets of life in New York City, written in the late 19th century. The book offers a vivid portrayal of the city's splendors and destitution, analyzing its wealth and poverty, societal dynamics, and notable events.
